lines.speaker: miranda
lines.text: Commander, I'm in deep trouble!

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.text: Poli is super angry at me

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.text: and I haven't got a clue why.
Maybe you did something wrong without knowing it?
Did you make a foul-up while on the job?

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.text: I can almost guarantee I did, but

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.text: there's no way I can narrow down

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.text: which one set her off.
Maybe it's a straw that broke the camel's back situation.

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.text: So you're saying

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.text: what made her blow a fuse was all the things I've done wrong put together?

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.text: If it was just one or two mistakes,

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.text: I was going to try and fix them behind her back and apologize later.
Don't do it secretly.

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.text: I'm really up against it this time.

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.text: What am I gonna do? T^T

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.text: When I first came to this department,

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.text: Poli was my senior officer and really took care of me.

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.text: Even if I try my best, I still keep screwing up...
Everyone's like that at a new job.
Looking after new recruits is part of Poli's job description.

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.text: You think so?

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.text: Even if that's true,

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.text: I want to be more reliable!

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.text: You think so?

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.text: Even if that's true,

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.text: I want to be someone Poli can rely on!

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.text: What am I gonna doooooo :'(
Miranda?
There's no reply.

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.text: Sorry about that, Commander!

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.text: Something came up and we were sent out on dispatch.

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.text: I just returned.

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.text: Some terrorist was trying to push a civilian off a building.

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.text: I ended up defying orders

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.text: so that I could rush over and catch the civilian.

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.text: I thought Poli was going to

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.text: chew me out again, but...
You got off scot-free?

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.text: Yep!

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.text: Well, not exactly.

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.text: Poli was pretty peeved at first

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.text: but she eventually said I did well, and even gave me a hug.

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.text: Honestly, sometimes I don't know what's going on in that head of hers.
You'll understand when you're responsible for your own new recruit.

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.text: Wow!

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.text: A new recruit under my command!

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.text: It's hard to imagine right now,

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.text: but if it does happen, I'll be really kind to them.

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.text: I'm not a proponent of tough love and stuff like that.
Just focus on the present for now.
You'll be quite a sight when that happens. Can't wait to see it.

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.text: You betcha!

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.text: But that's still a ways away.

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.text: You betcha!

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.text: Better mark your calendar!

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.text: Anyway, Poli is starting to give me some side eye,

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.text: so I better get back to work.

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.text: Thanks for everything!
